versions.content: By means of the configuration parameter FrNmPnFilterMaskByte the FrNm is able to detect which PN request information is relevant for the ECU and which not. Each bit of FrNmPnFilterMaskByte has the following meaning: 0 -> The PN request information is irrelevant for the ECU. 1 -> The PN request information is relevant for the ECU.
